prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a sideswipe while changing lanes claim. Injury: concussion. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1205; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a sideswipe collision during a lane change on a multi-lane roadway. Insured states the other vehicle moved into their lane without signaling. Both drivers reported as stopped at scene. Claimant reports concussion symptoms and has retained counsel, who has requested that all communication be routed through their office.

Entry 2: Police report obtained. Responding officer documented lane-change contact between the two vehicles, with minor damage to the rear quarter panel of the insured vehicle and the front passenger side of the claimant vehicle. Fault indicators point toward the other driver. Liability assessment pending review of scene photos and witness statements.

Entry 3: Claimant counsel's office confirmed representation in writing. Requested copies of the policy declarations page, the police report, and all photographs taken during the inspection. Documents to be sent after verification of the request and applicable privacy release. Medical records authorization requested through counsel; no direct contact with claimant to occur.

Entry 4: Medical documentation received from counsel. Claimant diagnosed with concussion following emergency department evaluation, with follow-up referral to neurology. Treating physician notes ongoing headaches, light sensitivity, and difficulty concentrating. Injury reserve adjusted to reflect reported severity. Referred file to bodily injury specialist for evaluation.

Entry 5: Independent medical review scheduled through counsel's office. Vehicle repair estimate completed and shared with the insured. Liability position remains under review pending the specialist's report. Next action: follow up with counsel on records status and confirm receipt of the independent review date.
